premises.scope: original-coordinate ratio packet; orthonormal product projection (S,R); disjoint normalized scalar banks Y,Z; exact Schur remainder lambda diag(m,0); mu=|det B||lambda|; packet mass m>=3/20
rank-two original-product receiver plus one disjoint scalar square with arbitrary same-receiver-bank shift and arbitrary affine term

partner_applied.inequality: ||p_Q||_infinity<51.6(mu m_*)^(-1/3); for mu>=1,m_*>=1/4 gives <81.91, including exact double-zero B=[[0,c],[c,0]], lambda=c^(-2)

new_result.statement: For the live ratio packet with B=[[a,c],[c,d]], delta_B=max(|a|,|d|)>0, exact Schur remainder lambda diag(m,0), and mu=|det B||lambda|, the packet output has an essentially bounded density with ||p_Q||_infinity<=128 sqrt(2)(delta_B mu m)^(-1/4). The estimate is sigma-free and kappa-free and does not condition R.
new_result.proof_resource: For a nonzero scalar pivot, the complementary Schur matrix N has rank two; |pdet N| equals the sum of absolute principal 2x2 minors; scalar Schur identities give Pi_pivot=|pivot||pdet N|>=mu m; complete the scalar as a translated fresh square and apply the product-preserving rank-two receiver.
new_result.regularity: absolute continuity plus essential bound only; continuity not proved

next_step: In the simultaneous regime delta_B->0, no quantitative exact-slope atom, and normalized residual-to-offdiagonal coupling->0, retain small diagonals exactly and prove that the third curvature forced by the spectral hypothesis appears in another original-coordinate aggregate that can be paid jointly before reciprocal minor inversion.
